map.λ × 核数 N 得活度。: λ times the number of nuclei N gives the activity.
map.已知 λ 与核数求衰变率。: Find the decay rate from λ and the number of nuclei.
map.A = 1e-9 × 1e20 = 1×10¹¹ Bq；核数增到 1e21 则: A = 1e-9 x 1e20 = 1×10¹¹ Bq; raising the number of nuclei to 1e21 gives A = 1e12 Bq.
map.若 th=ln2/λ=6.93e8s，则 A=(ln2/th)×N 等价，结果一: If th = ln2/λ = 6.93e8 s, then A = (ln2/th) x N is equivalent and gives the same result.
map.A=λN 与 A₀e^(−λt) 关系？: Relation between A = λN and A₀e^(-λt)?
map.前者是瞬时活度定义，后者是其随时间衰减规律，t=0 时一致。: The first is the definition of instantaneous activity and the second its decay over time; they agree at t = 0.
map.λ 的单位？: What is the unit of λ?
map.λ 单位为 s⁻¹（每秒衰变概率），N 为核数，故 A 为 s⁻¹ = Bq。: λ is in s⁻¹ (decay probability per second) and N is the number of nuclei, so A comes out in s⁻¹, i.e. Bq.
